edges.reason: constructor excludes owner and contract from fee

normalization_plan.reason: amount is an input parameter consumed by transfer and _transfer
sender parameter is the source address in _transfer
recipient parameter is the destination address in _transfer
account parameter is used by exclusion and blacklist management functions
newOwner parameter is the new owner address in transferOwnership
time parameter sets the lock duration in lock
tAmount parameter is the token amount in deliver
contractTokenBalance is computed in _transfer for swap threshold logic
totalCummulatives is computed in randwallet for lottery weighting
index is computed in randwallet for winner selection
winnerIndex is computed in randwallet as the selected lottery winner index
seed is computed in randtime for lottery timing randomness
maxTxPercent parameter sets the max transaction percentage
maxTx parameter sets the max transaction amount
